basic_details.job_title: IIIT Sri City, Chittoor Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Information Technology, Sri City, Chittoor (IIIT Sri City, Chittoor) is inviting applications for 1 project-based Junior Research Fellow (JRF) vacancy. Candidates applying for the post require a B.Tech./B.E. and M.Tech./M.E. in Electronics and communication/Equivalent with 60% or 6.5/10 CGPA and above, with a pay of Rs. 37,000 as per funding agency norm. Eligible applicants can submit their application through the online link only, along with an uploaded detailed Curriculum Vitae describing working knowledge and soft copies of Mark Sheets and Certificates. content_sections.heading: IIIT Sri City, Chittoor Junior Research Fellow (JRF) at a Glance

rows.details: Indian Institute of Information Technology, Sri City, Chittoor
Adaptive Mobile IoT Networks Using UAV-Assisted Weighted Federated Learning for Disaster Response
NMICPS Technology Innovation Hub on Autonomous Navigation Foundation (TiHAN)
Rs. 37000 (As per funding agency norm. No other allowances admissible.)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applicants must satisfy the educational qualifications prescribed for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post. Academic Qualifications: B.Tech./B.E. in Electronics and communication/Equivalent with 60% (or 6.5/10 CGPA) and above, AND M.Tech./M.E. in related areas/specializations of Electronics and communication/Equivalent with 60% (or 6.5/10 CGPA) and above. There is a 5% relaxation for SC/ST/PwD applicants. Skills Required (Essential): Knowledge in Drones/Sensors/Wireless Communication and basic knowledge on Federated learning. Skills Required (Desirable): (i) Very good hands on in ROS and standard navigation algorithms; (ii) Very good in Python/MATLAB programming; (iii) Good knowledge of 3D simulations of drones and experimental validation of different scenarios; (iv) Preference may be given to candidates who published papers (paid journals are not considered) in reputed Journals/Conferences.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected Junior Research Fellow (JRF) will receive a fellowship of Rs. 37,000 per month as per the funding agency norms, with no other allowances admissible. The project duration is around 6 months, and the association between the Principal Investigator and the candidate will automatically end on the closing date of the project.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIIT Sri City, Chittoor Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: Visit the online application link provided by the institute. Upload a detailed Curriculum Vitae describing your working knowledge as per the notification. Upload soft copies of your Mark Sheets and Certificates. Submit the application online on or before 20 October 2026. No email submissions are entertained.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Mere possession of the prescribed qualifications does not ensure that a candidate will be called for an interview. Shortlisting will be based on the needs of the project. Only shortlisted candidates will be informed by email about the interview date.

faq.question: Q1. Is the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post permanent or on contract, and for how long?
faq.answer: The position is purely temporary and associated with a project duration of around 6 months. The association with the institute will automatically end on the closing date of the project.

faq.question: Q2. Are there any HRA or additional allowances paid on top of the fellowship?
faq.answer: No other allowances are admissible apart from the fellowship of Rs. 37,000 per month as per funding agency norms.

faq.question: Q3. What relaxation in marks is available for reserved categories?
faq.answer: There is a 5% relaxation in the required academic percentage (or 6.5/10 CGPA) for SC/ST/PwD applicants.

faq.question: Q4. How are candidates shortlisted for the interview?
faq.answer: Shortlisting is done based on the needs of the project, and only shortlisted candidates will be informed by email regarding the interview date.

faq.question: Q5. Can selected candidates apply for a regular PhD program at IIIT Sri City?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates selected for this position can also apply for the regular PhD program in IIIT Sri City, provided they satisfy the eligibility criteria and the selection process laid down by the institute.
